title: Orbit Board v1.0.8 (Stable)
changelog: Two-Row Extended Action Bar: Word suggestions stay visible while all actions (Clipboard, Voice, Settings) expand in a dedicated second row
Probhat Layout More Keys Popup: Long-pressing 'য়' or 'য' opens the [ ্য | য | র্য ] popup panel for quick selection
Spacebar Name Pin Toggle: Choose to keep active keyboard name permanently pinned or allow it to smoothly fade out after switching
Independent Row Controls: Separate quick toggles for Suggestion Row and Number Row directly on Home settings
5-Row Alphabetical Bangla Layout Restored: Intuitive layout easily selectable alongside Avro, Jatiyo & Probhat
Language Selection Trap Fixed: Toggle or delete layouts freely without minimum keyboard traps
Performance & Size Optimization: Cleaned unneeded dictionaries and bloat for a fast, responsive typing experience
